events.event: Golkar Deputy Chairman Ahmad Doli Kurnia named eight possible replacements for Gibran as Vice President, saying Golkar leaves the choice to President Prabowo and will back his pick.
events.key_numbers: 8 names: Puan Maharani, Bahlil Lahadalia, Sufmi Dasco Ahmad, Sugiono, Ahmad Muzani, Muhaimin Iskandar, Zulkifli Hasan, AHY · statement Sat 14 Nov 2026
events.why_it_matters: The next Vice President will be chosen from names Prabowo submits, so who is on the list decides who sits one step from the presidency.
